content.text: /ext:medcp Choose a non-insulin medicine for type 2 diabetes and report how many patients used it here.
I'll pick **metformin** — the most widely prescribed first-line oral medication for type 2 diabetes. Let me look up its OMOP concept ID and then count patients with exposures.

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT c.concept_id, c.concept_name, c.standard_concept
FROM omop.concept c
WHERE Lower(c.concept_name) LIKE '%metformin%'
  AND c.vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm'
  AND c.domain_id = 'Drug'
LIMIT 10;
